summary: Both upper pairings at j are integrals of those at j + 1 over θ^F_j.

steps.lean:
F.formIntegrand j p q W x 1 := funext (by simp [← (Γ.isPairingKernel_self
  hk j).upperPairing_eq_integral_succ.2,
  ← (Γ.isPairingKernel_translatePairing hk hk.1 ..).upperPairing_eq_integral_succ.2, integral_conj])
steps.claim: For every g, expand upperPairing(F, j, …) as the θ^F_j-integral of upperPairing(F, j+1, …) for both kernels (upperPairing_eq_integral_succ, for the pairing kernels of isPairingKernel_self and isPairingKernel_translatePairing) and combine with the conjugate of an integral.
